task_completion.description: Load the IsPETase structure (PDB: 6EQE) into PyMOL.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL object list shows '6EQE' or a renamed object representing the protein structure.

task_completion.description: Identify and select the catalytic triad (Ser160, Asp206, His237) and Trp185.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Selection indicators (pink dots) or specific labels appear on residues 160, 206, 237, and 185 in the viewer.

task_completion.description: Measure the distance between Ser160 OG and His237 NE2.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dashed line (measurement wizard) appears between the side chains of Ser160 and His237 with a numerical value displayed in the viewport.

task_completion.description: Set the backbone to cartoon and the four specific residues to sticks.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The protein backbone is shown as a smooth ribbon/cartoon, while residues 160, 206, 237, and 185 are rendered as thick sticks with atomic coloring.

task_completion.description: Export the visualization as a PNG file to the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL command log shows a 'png' command or 'export' dialog directed to ~/PyMOL_Data/images/petase_active_site.png.

task_completion.description: Write the structural report with PDB ID, residue list, and measured distance.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal command shows the creation of 'petase_report.txt' containing the PDB ID 6EQE and the measured distance (approx 2.9-3.0 A).

integrity.description: The agent used the PyMOL GUI/command line rather than just creating a fake report file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the PyMOL application window active with the 3D structure rendered.

integrity.description: The distance measurement was performed using PyMOL tools, not hardcoded.
integrity.visual_evidence: The PyMOL 'measure' or 'dist' command/wizard is visible in the command history or viewport.

integrity.description: The agent saved files to the specific requested paths.
integrity.visual_evidence: Terminal or file explorer screenshots show the files at ~/PyMOL_Data/images/petase_active_site.png and ~/PyMOL_Data/petase_report.txt.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The PDB ID is 6EQE. The catalytic triad consists of Ser160, Asp206, and His237. The 'wobbling' tryptophan is Trp185. The expected hydrogen-bond distance between Ser160(OG) and His237(NE2) is approximately 2.94 Angstroms (acceptable range 2.2 to 4.2 A). The final image must be at least 30,000 bytes.
